messages:
ajay: Customer from FinServ just sent a CAIQ + BYO-KMS follow-up. They want: 1) confirmation of BYOK support across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, 2) who owns key rotation/audit logs, 3) any pricing uplift for KMS-backed Dedicated nodes. Can someone take point?

maria_s: I can draft the CAIQ answers for crypto controls. Quick Q: are they asking for tenant KMS (customer keys per-tenant) or org-level BYOK?

ajay: They said per-tenant BYOK if possible, but will accept per-org if not supported. Also asked if BYOK works with on-prem Private deployment.

derek: Short answers: Hosted: no tenant BYOK today (we manage keys), Dedicated: can support BKMS in some configs, Private (VPC / on-prem): yes BYOK (customer KMS) supported — but requires config + onboarding. Need to confirm exact gating for Dedicated.

katie: For Dedicated, we have two paths: a) use our KMS with customer-managed keys in cloud KMS (we rotate metadata), b) full customer KMS integration (limited to Dedicated clusters with network connect). I'll pull pricing delta.

maria_s: Drafting CAIQ snippets now. For "Key Custody" I'll state: "Hosted: Redwood-managed keys (not BYOK). Dedicated: supported with restricted pattern — contact AE for opt-in. Private: BYOK supported with customer KMS and HSM integrations." Want exact wording for "rotation" and "audit logs" from infra.

derek: Rotation: for BYOK in Private we defer rotation to customer KMS; we do not perform rewrap unless customer requests re-encryption during migrations. Audit logs: we emit key usage events to our audit stream but customers must enable their KMS audit logging to track KMS-side access.

katie: Pricing note: BYOK itself has no seat charge but Dedicated with BYOK/on-prem has an operational onboarding fee (~one-time) + possible monthly premium because of SLA/segregation. I'll confirm numbers with finance.

ajay: Can we also confirm fallback behavior? Customer wants to know if we can fallback to Redwood-managed keys during emergency and how that affects data access.

derek: We can implement an emergency fallback but only with documented customer opt-in in the contract and explicit key escrow steps. Not something we enable by default. I'll add that to the CAIQ response as "contractual fallback only."

maria_s: Uploaded the draft snippets here: https://redwood.internal/docs/caiq-snippets/byo-kms-draft.md Please review and comment inline.

katie: Looping in finance: @derek can you ping finance for exact uplift (onboarding + monthly) and the note about cancellation terms?

derek: Will do, pinging now.

sec-bot: IncidentBot: reminder — any BYOK/on-prem changes must pass Security review checklist SR-3 before onboarding.

ajay: Thanks all. Plan: maria_s finalizes CAIQ answers by EOD, katie confirms pricing by EOD+1, derek will supply the technical caveats and fallback wording. I'll assemble and send to customer. If anyone needs to hand off, say now.

maria_s: Got it — will update and mark changes with "[CAIQ-BYO]" tag.

katie: I'll put preliminary numbers in the thread once finance responds.

ajay: If the customer asks for a POC to validate BYOK in Dedicated, we should propose a 1-week POC with a Dedicated test cluster + minimal dataset. Thoughts?

derek: Agree. POC checklist: KMS config doc, network allowlist, audit capture, and run a short load test to validate latency impact. I'll draft checklist tonight.

maria_s: I'll add those checklist items to the CAIQ appendix.

ajay: Great — closing this thread once we have final CAIQ doc + pricing. Thanks team :thumbsup:
